reviews.author: Nathan Courvile

reviews.text: Can’t drive at all. Almost ran me off the road in Royse City. He jumped into the turn lane to get around me then ran a few cars into the ditch.
reviews.author: Hunter Boyer

reviews.text: I have never been more disappointed in an interaction with a business owner in my life. Therefore I am posting this as a fair warning for people working with this company. I just got off the phone with Greg from Cullen Pools. His company built the pool at my house roughly 3 years ago (prior to me moving in). We have had several issues with the pool leaking from different areas so I called to get information on plumbing layout and how to fix it. His response was telling me "it's pool building season, not pool fixing season". He refused to give me any contact information on who can fix our problems or even just the color they used on our deck to match it once we dig the whole thing up to fix the problem. When I asked if I could call back in the fall when they are less busy and who to call he proceeded to hang up on me and has now blocked my number. It took me 8 weeks to FINALLY get someone from that company to call me, as you have to leave your number with a 3rd party when you call, and I am just floored that he was so rude and inconsiderate.  Future buyers just know that any 'warranty' that company gives you is false. I have since read multiple incidences from the BBB where there have been problems with his installs and this situation has occurred.
reviews.author: Kate Davis

reviews.text: Greg Cullen had built two pools for me in the past and he does great work! He has a warranty that is better than any other pool company. Greg is honest, reasonable and very professional! The pools are built much better than code or what is required. They have been in business for a very long time, at least 35 years! I would always recommend Cullen Pools!!
reviews.author: Shawn Minskoff

reviews.text: Greg builds a top notch pool, that will probably last 30 to 50+ years. I am a real estate investor by trade, and I was impressed with his craftsmanship on the pool he put in my yard. Also, I've bought/resold a couple other houses in Rockwall county that had ~30 year old Cullen pools ... and they still worked. That's why I went with him, vs the competition, when my neighbor got a Cullen Pool & recommended him. Don't pick anyone else - pick Greg - if you want a pool that will last a lifetime.
reviews.author: Steve G

reviews.text: Let me start this by saying Im a very hard person to please and Mr. Cullen did impress me. Never would I have imagined this pool turning out the way it did. Mr. Cullen listened to us, asked great questions to make sure he knew what we wanted.  He kept us informed every step of the way.  We had no issues or problems before, during and after construction.  They are easy to get a hold of and I feel like we are not just customers, but friends for life. I was scared at first but now Im in love with his artistic work. His son was also involved and very professional through the process. I will give a piece of advice let the man do his job and just wait for his creation to take place.
reviews.author: Albert Magallon

reviews.text: Customer service and follow up is TERRIBLE. Left FOUR messages with the “answering service” and NO reply. Not even a courtesy we’re too busy, we don’t give a damn about the pools we built or the customers that have helped us stay in business. Can’t believe this attitude and disgusting customer service. A pool is not a small short term investment. Stay clear.
reviews.author: Chris White

data.summary: Reviews are highly authentic and paint a consistent, troubling picture of poor customer service, unprofessionalism, and refusal to support work post-completion, despite a pristine BBB record. The low rating is supported by credible, detailed complaints.
fake_signals: BBB A+ rating with zero complaints contradicts numerous severe public reviews
Potential for review suppression if negative experiences are not filed as formal BBB complaints
authentic_signals: Extremely specific and emotional complaints with names, dates, and detailed scenarios
Varied writing styles and specific project references (e.g., pool built 3 years prior)
One positive review mentions specific past projects and warranty, providing counterpoint
complaint_patterns: Refusal to honor warranty or provide post-build support
Damage caused by crew with no accountability
data.discrepancy_explanation: BBB shows A+ rating with no complaints, while Google and Houzz show low ratings (3.0, 3.3) with severe, detailed complaints. This suggests the BBB rating reflects complaint handling (none filed) rather than actual service quality, which is poor according to customer reviews.
